verdicts.reason: A breaks up the 'Baby & Toddler BEDDING' title: the ampersand and 'Baby/Toddler' sit in the middle of the banner with a wide dead gap before BEDDING, so the name no longer reads as one unit. The '&' is also clipped at the bottom, and the left dot grids are jammed against the edge. B keeps the original title together and keeps the photo strip running behind the '&'. Its flaws: the photo strip starts late, leaving a dead band on the left; BEDDING is smaller than in the original, leaving empty space to its right; and the tiny 'Baby/Toddler' text crowds into BEDDING.
